body: Chosen: plugin.Plugin, Lookuper, CommandRunner, ValueTransformer(path,value), ExpandObserver, Capability and Info are the base types and dotenv aliases them, so every existing dotenv plugin compiles unchanged. dotenv keeps EntryObserver (needs *Entry) and its own SaveGuard GuardSave(*File); it also detects the cross-format plugin.SaveGuard GuardSave(plugin.Document), which *dotenv.File implements. New base abilities: Resolver for ${scheme:ref} (only consulted when a resolver for that scheme is installed, so existing files read the same), Validator, Includer.
title: Base plugin interfaces: dotenv aliases most, keeps EntryObserver and SaveGuard(*File)
